betaTrichotomy.meaning: At fixed small delta, J has q-power 2 and D has q-power 6. Therefore J/D^beta diverges for beta<1/3, is scale-critical at beta=1/3, and vanishes for beta>1/3.

claimBoundary: This independent finite tangent-ledger calculation checks the limiting interpolation, root/slopes/tail, exact initial-data formula, D/J/rotational powers, delta^(4/3) factorization, and beta trichotomy for the fixed-geometry small-coupling branch. It does not prove the uniform continuum IFT or nonlinear PDE bounds, does not extend the endpoint payment to every triangular 2.5D solution or arbitrary 3D solution, and makes no Navier--Stokes regularity, novelty, or priority claim.
